03625 Kelach {keh'-lakh}

與03624同 ; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Calah 2; 2

迦拉 = "精力"
1) 亞述最古老的城市之一; 可能是現今的'Nimrud'
   位於底格裡斯河和 Zab 河的匯流點
record.edic_text:
03625 Kelach {keh'-lakh}

the same as 03624;; n pr loc

AV - Calah 2; 2

Calah = "vigour"
1) one of the most ancient cities of Assyria; maybe modern 'Nimrud'
   located at the confluence of the Tigris and Zab rivers
